name: FinalBurn Neo
description: An arcade emulator that recreates a large collection of classic arcade boards rather than a single machine, from Capcom CPS-1/2/3 and Neo Geo to Sega System 16, Toaplan and Cave. It continues the FinalBurn and FinalBurn Alpha lineage and is widely used for online play.

specs.cpu: Mostly Motorola 68000 and Zilog Z80 based boards
specs.sound: Mostly Yamaha FM and OKI ADPCM chips

curiosities: FinalBurn Neo was forked from FinalBurn Alpha in 2019.
It is the emulator used by the Fightcade online play service.
Besides arcade boards it also emulates several home systems, such as the Mega Drive and PC Engine.
story: FinalBurn began in 2000 as a Capcom CPS-2 emulator by Dave, and grew into FinalBurn Alpha, covering Neo Geo, CPS-1, CPS-2, CPS-3 and Toaplan, Cave and Data East boards.

In 2019 its developers renamed it FinalBurn Neo and opened it up again. It favours arcade games played as they were: accurate timing, netplay and run-ahead to cut input lag, light enough for small machines like the Raspberry Pi.

Today it is the usual way to play the golden age of 2D arcade fighters and shooters, from Street Fighter II and Metal Slug to the Cave danmaku games, on everything from phones to handheld retro consoles.
